overloadMerges.note: value has two documented sentinel values (0 = no space, 32000 = page break) in addition to its use as a signed spacing magnitude; modeled as sentinelValues.

params.name: value
params.description: Spacing below the subtotal row: a positive value is pixels, a negative value is a percentage of the row height (e.g. -100 = 100%)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets the vertical spacing (or forces a page break) below a given subtotal row; applies only to list-mode reports.

constraints: If the added space pushes the next row onto a following page, no space is inserted above that row on the new page.
